sn1.43:1.1: Annam evābhinandanti || ubhayo devamānusā || atha ko nāma so yakkho || yam annaṃ nābhinandatīti || ||
sn1.43:2.1: Ye naṃ dadanti saddhāya || vippasannena cetasā || tam eva annaṃ bhajati || asmiṃ loke paramhi ca || ||
sn1.43:3.1: Tasmā vineyya maccheraṃ || dajjā dānaṃ malābhibhū || puññāni paralokasmiṃ || patiṭṭhā honti pāṇinan ti || ||
